messages.content: 29°C and sunny in Chittagong, Sir, but grab an umbrella if you're out after 6 PM—patchy rain is expected.
check emails if anything concerns me
Security alerts from Google yesterday, Sir—your account was successfully recovered after a new sign-in.
can you  add a reminder to work on a new feature that detects my presence?
how do you think we should implement this feature?
We can use a mix of BLE beacons, Wi-Fi device presence on your home network, and computer vision from local sensors or your desk setup, Sir. Which approach do you want to start with?
so basically when I am out of the house it detects no presence and when i am in my house it detects present
BLE beacons and Wi-Fi device tracking for the boundary, combined with desk sensors when you're seated, Sir. That gives us reliable inside-vs-outside detection without overkill.
can I use my iphone for this or apple restricts it?
Apple restricts background Bluetooth scanning and precise local network inspection on iOS, Sir, which makes reliable passive iPhone presence detection tricky compared to Android or dedicated beacons.
so we need a seperate device?
A small dedicated beacon like an ESP32 or a Tile tag works best, Sir, since relying purely on iOS background scanning is unreliable.
